attribution: AWS Terrain Tiles (terrarium) -- SRTM/NED/GMTED se bana, AWS Open Data Registry par khula. Koi API key nahi.

files.heightmap.png: RGB8. elevation = min + ((R*256 + G) / 65535) * (max - min). Web game.
files.heightmap_16.png: 16-bit grayscale, same normalisation. Godot / Blender / GIS.

orientation: row 0 = north edge (z = -half), col 0 = west edge (x = -half)

road_carving.$comment: Sadak ke corridor mein terrain uske mulayam profile ki taraf kheencha gaya hai -- asli cut-and-fill ka sasta roop. Bina iske 30 m ka DEM sadak ko pahad ke upar oopar-neeche daudata hai.
